text:
incident-bot: PAGE: sre-oncall 1264 1: Streaming-gateway error surge detected. Symptom: increased 5xx + early stream terminations. Window 5m: 5xx=7.2%, client_disconnects up 480%. Severity: P2. Alert: https://monitoring/redux/alerts/18190

sre-oncall: acknowledged, jumping in.

MJ: dashboards show spike aligns with a deploy 09:05 UTC to edge-proxy cluster (rolling).

Ravi: logs show a pattern of `http2: stream reset` on upstreams plus `bad chunked trailer` in proxies. Example: ```
[edge-proxy] 2026-02-11T09:06:12Z conn=xyz upstream=10.1.7.8:443 err="recv frame: RST_STREAM"
[gateway] 2026-02-11T09:06:15Z stream=stream-77 trailer_checksum_mismatch=true
```

Elena: client libraries are also reporting `net/http: unexpected EOF` from many regional SDKs. Could be either our proxy sending malformed chunked encoding or clients dropping on first non-data frame.

infra-bot: Recent deploys: edge-proxy v2.18.3 deployed to eu-west-1 at 09:04 UTC; rolling out 6 instances.

MJ: rollback candidate? Can we pause the rollout for the edge-proxy?

Ravi: quick scan: host-level kernel logs show `tcp_abort_on_overflow` counters ticked on a handful of nodes. Might be socket buffer exhaustion with sudden spike in concurrent streams.

Kai: running `ss -s` on an exemplar node: `TCP: inuse 1080 orphaned 0 tw 5 alloc 1200 mem 80000`. Not extreme but ephemeral bursty.

Support: runbook check: customers impacted list by query `top_customers_by(stream_errors, 15m)`. Results: gamma-retail (42% of their streams failed), dev-tools (12%), others single-digit.

MJ: immediate mitigations proposal: 1) Pause edge-proxy rollout, 2) Temporarily enable HTTP/1.1 fallback for streaming clients that don't require HTTP/2, 3) Increase proxy socket buffers and reduce max concurrent streams per connection to avoid head-of-line.

Elena: adding: throttle large-chunk producers: if chunk_size > 16k -> respond 429 with body explaining temporary limit. That reduces per-stream memory usage.

sre-oncall: action plan starting now: A) pause deploy in eu-west-1, B) enable `http1-fallback=true` via feature flag for streaming route, C) bump `proxy.max_concurrent_streams` from 250 -> 80 on rolling nodes, D) notify CS for top tenants. Executing A & B now.

infra-bot: deploy pause initiated by sre-oncall at 09:12:32 UTC.

sre-oncall: feature flag toggle: `POST /ops/flags/edge.http1-fallback {"enabled":true}` -> applied 09:13:04 UTC.

Ravi: after toggles, 5xx dropped from 7.2% -> 3.6% within ~2m. However gamma-retail still sees intermittent terminations.

MJ: digging into gamma logs: client SDKs using long-polling behave better under http1-fallback; but we still see trailer checksum failures from about 3% of streams originating from the ap-southeast ingress.

Elena: hypothesis: an older intermediate LB (partner-ilb) doing HTTP/2 proxying is cutting trailers when idle-timeouts hit. That would produce checksum/trailer mismatches.

Kai: I can force-route ap-southeast traffic away from partner-ilb to our native LB pool. Quick command: `routectl set-backends --pool ap-southeast native-lb-only`.

sre-oncall: apply route change, carefully, starting with one AZ.

infra-bot: routing update applied for ap-southeast-az1 at 09:18:50 UTC.

Support: sending targeted note to gamma-retail support contacts with suggested workaround: enable SDK retry-on-eof and accept paged fallback for large responses. Ticket #81002 opened.

Ravi: after AZ routing change, gamma-retail errors dropped to ~6% -> now 1.4% over 10m window. Global streaming disconnects reduced by ~45%.

MJ: further mitigation: increase proxy write buffer: `sysctl -w net.core.wmem_max=16777216` and `net.core.rmem_max=16777216` on suspect nodes. Rolling to 2 nodes now.

Elena: also switching internal keepalive: `http2_idle_timeout` lowered from 120s -> 30s to prompt earlier stream resets rather than half-closed ambiguous states.

sre-oncall: flags applied, buffer bump rolled to 2 nodes, monitoring.

Kai: added temporary tracing hook: `edge-proxy:trace=stream-chunk` for 20m to capture `SETTINGS`/`RST_STREAM` pairs and full chunk frames.

infra-bot: tracing hook enabled at 09:23:01 UTC.

Ravi: log sample shows `SETTINGS_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS` adjustment mid-connection from partner-ilb causing our proxy to close streams: `frame: SETTINGS max_concurrent_streams=50` then immediate `RST_STREAM` for preexisting streams. If true, this is likely a partner misconfiguration.

MJ: next steps: 1) file escalation to partner network ops (Elena), 2) schedule post-incident follow-up to harden our trailer validation and add metric `trailer_checksum_fail_rate`, 3) consider adding HTTP/1.1 streaming compatibility mode for SDKs.

Elena: contacting partner team now, sending examples and traces.

sre-oncall: current status at 09:27 UTC: incident mitigated but not fully resolved. 5xx steady ~1.2%, client cancels low. Major tenants notified; gamma-retail on support ticket.

Kai: preparing handoff doc for night team: listing commands to revert http1-fallback, rolling change steps for `proxy.max_concurrent_streams`, location of traces and logs: https://logs/redux/query/trace-2185001234 and runbook link https://runbooks/redux/streaming-chunked-incident.md

sre-oncall: handing off to Ravi (night oncall) at 09:29 UTC. Conditions: mitigations in place (http1-fallback, reduced concurrent streams, routing avoidance of partner-ilb, buffer increases). Escalate to infra if trailer_fail_rate > 0.5% for 10m.

Ravi: acknowledged. I will keep trace hook for another 10m, then lower to sample rate 1%. Will coordinate with Elena on partner response.

Support: gamma-retail update posted on status page and customers with recent errors emailed.

incident-bot: auto-close suppressed. Next mandatory update in 1h or on condition change.

sre-oncall: quick postmortem notes: probable root cause: partner ILB altering HTTP/2 settings mid-connection leading to RST_STREAMs + our proxy assuming trailers intact -> checksum failures. Contributing factors: edge-proxy rollout + conservative default max_concurrent_streams. Remediations: partner engagement, add trailer_fail metric, make streaming fallbacks more robust, improve canary for edge-proxy rollouts. Handoff complete.

Ravi: leaving this thread open; will post final incident summary once partner responds. :white_check_mark:
